mechanism: Official RISC Zero finite-field backend via risc0-bigint2 under target_os=zkvm,target_arch=riscv32; ordinary upstream field backend on native host
integration: Separate Cargo workspace patches crates.io bls12_381 for the exact same verifier core and guest source paths. Original rust/Cargo.lock remains stock. No claim of inherited audit coverage.
optimized_pairing: core combined-pairing feature uses upstream multi_miller_loop and a single final_exponentiation to check e(pk,H(m))*e(-g1,sig)==1
round_1_config: bls-only/Cargo.toml: BLS finite-field patch only; combined-pairing disabled, SHA2 unpatched
direct_build_environment: RISC0_FEATURE_bigint2=1 required for the official bigint2 guest backend when building without risc0-build
